title: Cover Palette
description: Hover any Beatles album and the whole player re-themes from its cover: six colours are pulled from the artwork in a canvas, and every surface, line, ink and accent slides to its new value through OKLCH, with a share-weighted swatch strip you can copy from.
intent: Album art as a live theme source: the palette is computed, not hand-picked, and each role eases on its own lightness, chroma and hue axes so the colour never passes through mud.
